question: Who was the first person to walk on the Moon?
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Neil Armstrong'.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• American astronaut and aeronautical engineer **Neil Alden Armstrong** became the first person to set foot on the moon.
 
• He also went on to become a navy pilot, check pilot, and professor.
 
• Armstrong was born and raised in Wapakonet
